quotes.text: The Swiss National Bank is leaving the SNB policy rate unchanged at 0%.
The SNB remains willing to be active in the foreign exchange market as necessary.
Inflation in recent months has been slightly lower than expected.
The SNB will continue to monitor the situation and adjust its monetary policy if necessary, in order to ensure price stability.
The forecast is within the range of price stability over the entire forecast horizon (cf. chart).
